name: explainer-video
description: Short silent explainer videos made with ManimCE. The produce skill plans the beats, writes one scene script (Text for words, MathTypst for math), renders it at low quality first, and checks every render: ffprobe confirms one video stream, no audio and the scene's duration, a frame is extracted after every animation and read back as an image, and overlapping text or an element cut off by the frame edge fails the run. Videos are views and are written outside any record bundle. A SessionStart hook installs the hash-locked Python packages into the plugin data directory; the check skill reports whether Python, ManimCE, ffmpeg and ffprobe are ready.
